crossRefs.note: Then the king commanded, and they brought Daniel, and cast him into the den of lions. The king spoke and said to…
A stone was brought, and laid on the mouth of the den; and the king sealed it with his own signet, and with the signet…
Many are the afflictions of the righteous, but Yahweh delivers him out of them all.
You brought us into prison. You laid a burden on our backs.
You allowed men to ride over our heads. We went through fire and through water, but you brought us to the place of…
If it had not been Yahweh who was on our side, let Israel now say,
Then they took Jeremiah and threw him into the dungeon of Malchijah the king’s son, that was in the court of the guard.…
They have chased me relentlessly like a bird, those who are my enemies without cause.
For we don’t desire to have you uninformed, brothers, concerning our affliction which happened to us in Asia, that we…
For our light affliction, which is for the moment, works for us more and more exceedingly an eternal weight of glory,
Beloved, don’t be astonished at the fiery trial which has come upon you to test you, as though a strange thing happened…
But because you are partakers of Christ’s sufferings, rejoice, that at the revelation of his glory you also may rejoice…

translations.web: These three men, Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego, fell down bound into the middle of the burning fiery furnace.
translations.bsb: And these three men, Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego, firmly bound, fell into the blazing fiery furnace.
translations.kjv: And these three men, Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego, fell down bound into the midst of the burning fiery furnace.
translations.asv: And these three men, Shadrach, Meshach, and Abed-nego, fell down bound into the midst of the burning fiery furnace.
